outcome: Correlation between bile acid levels and PR interval
Changes in PR interval after ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA) administration
cohort: 110 pregnant women with ICP and 72 pregnant women without ICP (controls)
finding: Fetuses of women with ICP had significantly longer PR intervals compared to controls, and PR interval was positively correlated with maternal bile acid levels; UDCA administration was associated with a significant decrease in fetal PR interval.
